Dr Allison Koh is a Research Fellow in Natural Language Processing at the University of
Birmingham’s Centre for Artificial Intelligence in Government. She earned her PhD at the Hertie School’s Centre for International
Security in Berlin. Her research predominantly concerns frontier technology governance and nonstate actors in global politics, with recent projects investigating the role of frontier AI labs in international policymaking and
public sensemaking of disruptions in digital infrastructure. Beyond academic research, she
advises scholars, civil society organisations, and human rights practitioners on responsible
AI adoption.
